filler2scents.intro: You briefly stop to smell the air, two diverging scents reaching your nose. Interesting.

Follow the sweet scent: Initiates claiming a New Befriended Wolf

details: Befriending is not available if your territory is full.

fillerbirdrest.intro: You hear the faint twitter of birds somewhere nearby. You look up to the sky and watch them swooping overhead. What would it feel like to fly? You find a nice comfortable spot in the shade and rest for a moment.

fillerbutterfly.intro: Catching your breath, a small butterfly lands on your nose.

Chomp: +1 random recipe from butterfly pool*//+1% hunger

notes: *Blinded Sphinx|imgrecipeanimal;imgblindedsphynx, Brown Longtail|imgrecipeanimal;imgbrownlongtail, Canyon Rubyspot|imgrecipeanimal;imgcanyonrubyspot, Diana Fritillary|imgrecipeanimal;imgdianafritillary, Fiery Skipper|imgrecipeanimal;imgfieryskipper, Giant Swallowtail|imgrecipeanimal;imggiantswallowtail, Gulf Fritillary|imgrecipeanimal;imggulffritillary, Uhler's Arctic|imgrecipeanimal;imguhlersarctic, White Peacock|imgrecipeanimal;imgwhitepeacock

fillercritters.intro: You see some small critters running desperately in the opposite direction.

Keep Moving Forward: Automatic battle with level (LVL+5) local enemy @location1

fillerdirtsnuffle.intro: You snuffle around in the dirt. It's here somewhere.. Yes! Jackpot!

fillerscentpath.intro: You catch a strange scent on the ground, a mingling of two different scents. You follow them until they part ways.

Follow West: +1 random meat chunks item**//+1 random cave-building material***

fillerwaterpool.intro: A small pool of water appears up ahead, and as you approach you notice that there is a dim blue light glowing from beneath the surface of the water.

checkoutpoop.intro: You come across some poop... Normally, you'd roll all over it, but for some reason, something seems special about this poop.
details: If your lead wolf is currently immune to illness.

herbs.intro: You wander across some interesting plants growing from the soil. You give them a sniff.. oooh, herbs!

aggressivegoldeneagle.intro: A peculiar sound caught your attention. You rarely hear something like this and your curiosity is stronger than your common sense. What you stumbled upon is no ordinary eagle's nest. While you've encountered them in the past, they are usually empty. However, this time is different – you spotted the white fluff of eagle chicks, checking you from the distance.

albinoravenmerchant.intro: A beautiful albino raven merchant has set up shop among some roots. You both look curiously at each other.

americancrowbuyer.intro: With a flutter of wings, you are accosted by an American crow with the most unique looking pouch. It seeks to trade things, but when you ask where the wares are, it expresses they are well hidden, very, very high. Fine then, keep your secrets.

americancrowseller.intro: You find a spot where an adorable American crow is selling shiny things. You don't have your silver cones with you, but maybe you can offer something more specific?
details: This result can give '''ANY''' recipe in the game.

americancrowtrader.intro: A big American crow with a curious-looking pouch lands in front of you, asking if you have cool items to trade. Let's see...

americanpika.intro: A little furry brown American Pika comes bounding up to you, seemingly determined and unafraid of you.

americanrobin.intro: In a flurry of feathers, a robin flies in front of your face, startled into flight by your passing!
details: If your lead wolf is currently immune to illness.

anhinga.intro: A beautiful anhinga clings to a branch, its eyes trained on the water below as it looks for prey.

barnowl.intro: A barn owl swoops overhead, clutching something in its talons. Maybe something tasty?

beaver.intro: A beaver appears startled at your sudden appearance, it seems to be in the middle of collecting materials.

Growl: +1 random recipe from cave-building material pool*
+1 random recipe from rare jay pool**

blackneckedgrebe.intro: This black-necked grebe is diving for something beneath the surface.
details: Unless you have an active item quest with the questing snake, this option will always have no result.

blacktailedjackrabbit.intro: The sight of the long ears makes you tighten your jaw unconsciously. Your instincts have kicked in and you feel the need to chase the rabbit!

blackwidow.intro: A large black widow has just started spinning its web as night approaches. It's hauntingly beautiful and almost hypnotizing to watch.

bluejay.intro: A blue jay is aggressively chasing and screaming at another bird - presumably one that got too close to its nest. In the chaos, you notice something fall to the ground in front of you.

breedingnorthernpikes.intro: The loud, sudden sound of splashing intrigues you. As you move closer, you witness a rare and fascinating event: the northern pike breeding season. The water is filled with their energy, and their scales shimmer beautifully. It's mesmerizing!

campinghumans.intro: There's humans here! They've set up a funny cave and talk loudly in a circle. A delicious smell drifts from their funny box...hmm!

campinghumans2.intro: The forest is always full of various scents but only one type of creature feels foreign every time you feel its presence. When you follow the unusual scent, you discover a group of humans talking in front of an artificial structure that appears to be their place to sleep. How long do they plan to stay here?

carolinaanole.intro: You spot a green Carolina anole resting on a tree branch. Its throat is enlarged, and its vivid colouring may mean it's not so good to eat.

carolinachickadee.intro: The sound of two tiny birds catches your attention. When you look up, you see them right above your head, focused on their flight and unaware of your presence.

chihuahuanravenmerchant.intro: You excitedly trot towards the chihuahuan raven merchant, asking what's in store today. The raven seeks special items and wonders if you have any.

chirpingbirds.intro: A group of brightly colored birds sits among the leaves of a tree above your head, chatting up a storm. You don't speak bird, but they seem to be gossiping about something.

commonravenmerchant.intro: A low croak from above catches your attention. A big common raven merchant is seeking some items to refill its stock.

cottontail.intro: A small fluffy bunny sits alert in the grass.

cougarmom.intro: You stopped in mid-step upon noticing a large cougar on your path. And it wasn't alone. A young cub was attempting to keep pace with its mother as fast as it could with its short legs and still a bit wobbly movement. It’s a cute scenery but the cougar doesn't appear particularly thrilled by your presence.

crowsnakeskinpurveyor.intro: What a fancy crow! It shows off its latest purchases, obviously fascinated by all types of shed snake skins. Maybe you have some for trade?

dallsheep.intro: A Dall sheep leaps across your path, too busy focusing on keeping its footing to notice you. Mutton on the menu, perhaps?
details: If your lead wolf is currently sick.
If your lead wolf is currently immune to illness.

deadcow.intro: A familiar scent reaches your nose before you can see its source. You see a large, dead cow. It's still very fresh and looks as if it only died moments ago.

deertrappedinice.intro: You notice the silhouette of a deer in the distance. It struggles to move and keeps falling. The ice has trapped it!

devildiver.intro: The whooping call of a devil diver pulls you to the nearby water, and you watch as it flies into the air, clearly disturbed by something.

easternchipmunk.intro: An eastern chipmunk is perched upon the tree trunk, gingerly washing itself. As it notices you it leaps from the trunk and scurries off.

easterncrowhawker.intro: The loud croaking of this eastern crow hawker announces the gathering of raven traders nearby.

ebonyjewelwing.intro: A beautiful ebony jewelwing flies past your head and lands on a small branch up ahead of you.

eel.intro: You notice a long, black form wriggling in the mud up ahead. It's an eel!

egg.intro: You stop in your tracks - a very vulgar wolf is passing by, vandalizing the bird nests in the vicinity. Oh no, the eggs!

eveningbat.intro: A dark shadow dashes in front of your eyes, so silent that it startles you. When you focus your gaze on it, you recognize a bat in the middle of hunting.

faultysteelwolftrap.intro: Suddenly, an intense pain spreads throughout your body, something feels as if it grabbed your leg suddenly, but you can pull it out gently. One of your legs was scraped by something metallic!

fishcrowmerchant.intro: On a rotten trunk among the tall trees, a fish crow croaks at you, inviting you to check out its wares. Looks like there's a high demand for certain items.

fishermen.intro: Humans with long sticks are standing by the nearby waterway. They wave them around and you watch as a line goes into the water. They smell of fish. What are they doing?

fivelinedskink.intro: A small lizard is relaxing on warm rocks nearby. It seems that it's aware of your presence but is choosing to ignore you.

floridacrowhawker.intro: At first you are annoyed by the croaking, but once you listen carefully, you manage to make out that the Florida crow hawker is directing animals to the nearest crow merchant.

frozendeer.intro: At first glance, this deer looks almost as if it's alive, but when you move closer, you realize that it's completely frozen and already torn into by another predator. What's most surprising is that you notice a tiny fawn by its side. It doesn't look at you and pretends to be invisible.

gartersnake.intro: This charming little snake slithers around in the grass and over the top of a large rock to peek from higher ground. It seems to be looking for something.
details: Unless you have an active item quest with the questing snake, this option will always have no result.

greatblueheron.intro: A magnificent, gigantic great blue heron clatters its bill at you as a warning sign. Is the warning for you, or for its peers?

greatersagegrouse.intro: Careful, straight ahead! A greater sage-grouse male seems to be prowling for challengers.

greenheron.intro: A green heron wanders along nearby slow-moving water. It's observing the swimming shadow of a fish. You can tell it hasn't yet noticed you.

hikers.intro: A group of humans is passing by, their voices echoing loudly enough to make the whole area aware of their presence. You're close enough to catch intriguing scents. Their bags must be full of treats and trinkets!

housefinch.intro: A tiny bird sits on a nearby bush, observing you as its head tilts in curiosity.

lampshadespider.intro: A dark mass caught in a web draws your gaze. It's a lampshade spider, sitting on her nest. Creepy!

lavendergrass.intro: The beautiful sight of lavender grass swaying gently in the wind, the buzzing of bees, and the serenity surrounding you make you want to stay here for a while.

leastweasel.intro: You spot this small least weasel standing on a rock. How cute!

leucisticravenmerchant.intro: Your eyes water in awe when checking out all the pretty wares this leucistic raven merchant has in store. You ask if it's looking for anything to trade, but it's hard to hide your delight. The prices might be high!

longearedowl.intro: What a struggle! This long-eared owl just caught a gray ratsnake!

longtailedweasel.intro: A long-tailed weasel tries to slip past you, holding a rat carcass in its jaws.

mallard.intro: A beautiful male mallard duck is trying to impress a bored-looking female.

migratingbirds.intro: A large flock of birds clogs the sky and nearly blocks out the sun. There's hundreds of them! It must be their annual migration.

migratingwoodcocks.intro: A flock of chattering woodcocks fly annoyingly around your head. Don't they have anything better to do?

milksnake.intro: A peculiar rustling sound catches your attention, leading you to an intriguing sight. You discover a nest full of eggs where a milk snake is about to devour one of them.

mountainbeaver.intro: This mountain beaver is caught off-guard outside of its burrow! It quickly shows you its enormous teeth before you consider attacking. Yes, it's best not to engage.

Offer Acorn: +1 random recipe from cave-building material pool**

mountainchickadee.intro: Chickadees are supposed to be small and cute, but why must they be so loud? Its shrill calls echo in your ears as it peers down at you without remorse.

mountaingoat.intro: A mountain billy goat is very determined not to allow you to pass any further.

Growl: +1 random recipe from cave-building material pool*

ninebandedarmadillo.intro: A small Nine-Banded Armadillo sits cleaning itself before turning and trotting off.

northamericanriverotter.intro: A curious otter asks you to play! You're busy, but...the otter is too cute to resist.

northerncardinal.intro: A beautiful red cardinal sings its song on a branch above your head. How lovely!

northernpygmyowl.intro: A northern pygmy owl is staring down at you from the low-hanging branch of a tree. Its head is rotating in all directions as the wide, open eyes follow your every move.

northwesterncrowhawker.intro: A small, Northwestern Crow Hawker is announcing arrival of raven traders in the area.

opossum.intro: You spot an opossum on a tree branch above. It watches you closely, wary.

paintedturtle.intro: Small and brightly colored, a little painted turtle stretches out on a nearby log, looking out over the territory. Is it watching for predators?

peregrinefalcon.intro: A Peregrine Falcon soars overhead, it's impossibly fast, you almost don't notice it. You watch as something drops from it.

piedravenpeddler.intro: Whoah! A magnificent pied raven peddler is inviting you to check out the fresh stock in their shop. You're more interested in its feathers at first, but soon enough you learn what the bird is interested in.

porcupine.intro: Spiky and with a face only a mother could love, a porcupine perches on a rock and stares you down.

prancingfawns.intro: Two very young fawns are having fun prancing around. They haven't noticed you, and there is no sign of other deer nearby. Do they know that it's dangerous to be far away from their herd?

pumpkinpatch.intro: What a sight! Lots of huge, fresh, and almost perfectly round pumpkins are lying around, ready to be tended to.

raccoon.intro: This angry Raccoon seems to be guarding something. Hmmm...

rainbowtrout.intro: The strong smell of fish captures your attention, and you spot a rainbow trout's body shining on the nearby rocks. It's still very fresh and very tempting but you're not the sole visitor eager to claim it. It looks like a raccoon is also trying to get closer to the fish!

raven.intro: A raven swoops down over your head and seems to be trying to get your attention.

Follow: +1 random item from raven feather pool*
+1 random recipe from rare jay pool*****

ravenantlerpurveyor.intro: You notice a big raven showing off its antler collection. It's looking for more. Maybe you have something to offer?

ravenbeakdealer.intro: When you spot a raven with a broken beak, you worry if it's able to feed properly, but you discover it has its own shop dedicated to beaks, and a few helpers moving things around. Looks like no matter what, it's making the best of its situation! Maybe it's looking to expand the collection?

ravenhoofdealer.intro: Fascinated by legs in many shapes and colours, this raven dealer seems to be eager to enhance their collection. You notice its white eye, but it seems to be watching your behaviour with a proper judgemental expression.

ravenshelldealer.intro: Stashed in all the nooks and crannies of an old, wiggly tree, are beautiful shells of all colours and sizes. The owner of the shop asks if you have anything cool to trade.

redbelliedwoodpecker.intro: Loud, rhythmic knocking makes you feel like something is drilling into your head. A red-bellied woodpecker is the source of the irritating noise, of course.
details: Unless you have an active item quest with the questing snake, this option will always have no result.

redsquirrel.intro: A red squirrel is perched on a branch, clasping what looks like a pinecone in its paws. It would be a shame if it dropped it...

rockymountaintoad.intro: A thick, fat, and juicy Rocky Mountain toad is resting on this comfortable rock, protected from the weather by a coat of mucus and mud.

sasquatchinthemist.intro: Your eyes catch movement in the mist ahead. The form looks human, and yet...it's furry, too. What could it be?

sharptailedgrouse.intro: These two male Sharp-Tailed Grouse are making a lot of noise! Feathers fly as these ridiculous creatures viciously attack each other, scrambling for dominance over mating rights for a nearby female.

shortearedowl.intro: A familiar shape catches your attention. It's an owl, staring at you so intensely that it's a bit unnerving.

sinaloacrowmerchant.intro: You haven't seen anything like this before - a sinaloa crow merchant is carrying all the goods in a human-made basket. It all smells like delicious food, and even the fake tiny human smells fun. You have seen those before! Maybe it's looking for more?

snowman.intro: Big balls of snow are stacked on top of each other and seem to be dressed in human things. What a strange thing to do!

southerncrowhawker.intro: You spot a southern crow hawker high in the sky as it announces a gathering of merchants just down by the river.

southernflyingsquirrel.intro: You notice a small critter flying through the air.. what on earth? You take a closer look - seems to be a Southern Flying Squirrel!

spottedskunk.intro: Balancing on its front legs, a skunk raises its bum in your direction, ready to spray!

stripedskunk.intro: This looks like an interesting, perhaps tasty creature... On second thought, it smells bad. Very very bad. Rancid, even. Time to run away!

swarmingrats.intro: Individually, a single rat may make for a satisfying snack, but a bunch of them can turn into a feast no worse than much larger prey. The way they try to escape triggers your hunter instincts even more.

tala.intro: Oh no! It's Tala! She seems to be taunting you for a little payback after the last fight. Are you brave enough to wrestle her?

Attack!: Automatic battle with enemy Wandering Tala

tamaulipascrowhawker.intro: You jump, surprised by the loud croaking of a tamaulipas crow hawker. Looks like new merchants are moving in somewhere near your den.

trumpeterswan.intro: A trumpeter swan flying by has startled you!

westerncrowhawker.intro: Here ye, here ye! The big raven market is opening nearby! This western crow hawker is busy announcing the location of new traders to all local animals.

wildturkey.intro: This tom turkey is strutting and making drumming noises. Perhaps there are some females nearby he is trying to impress.

wolf.intro: A figure appears up ahead of you, you raise your nose to the air and sniff.. another wolf!

Befriend: Initiates claiming a New Befriended Wolf

woodhousesscrubjay.intro: Two woodhouse's scrub jays are foraging for food. This place must be nice!

Chase: +1 random recipe from cave-building material pool*

yellowbelliedmarmot.intro: Two fluffy marmots have come out of their burrow anxiously, as if they can sense your presence.

yellowpinechipmunk.intro: You notice a tiny creature hiding in a fallen tree. You stay still and quiet and after a while, the creature reveals itself, looking at you with curiosity. It's a yellow-pine chipmunk, searching for something to eat.

lunardig.intro: A faint scent of something special is right down this slope...

lunarhpfiller.intro: You feel dizzy, perhaps from inhaling too much lunar essence. When you lie down, your body twitches like you're waking up from a dream, but you're still awake.

lunarscent.intro: You lift your head to catch a scent of something familiar in this blue world. You recognise something among the bitter mushroom spores.

ancientfox.intro: A lonesome fox is sitting on your path. When you approach, an essence-filled mist encircles it, whipping blue veils of dust around. The fox is offering a small game of chance, which you cannot lose. You must simply pick one of the blue, glowing orbs - once you pay a fee, of course.

anotherdreamingwolf.intro: A familiar shape has caught your eye. A wolf from your world crosses the path before you. In this glowing realm, a creature without this feature always looks out of place. You realize how much you both stand out.

arguingwolves.intro: You encounter two wolves traversing this world, much like you are. They seem to have gotten into a quarrel. Lunar essence is charging between them!

aurorarat.intro: You find a glowing rat, hopping in slow motion as if gravity does not hold it to solid ground like it does to you.

aurorastoat.intro: Ahead, you see an aurora stoat climbing gracefully on rocks and trees, almost as though it were flying. The creature is probably trying to catch some dinner. It touches the ground finally after slowly falling down, all the while watching you with alert, glowing eyes.

barkraccoon.intro: A raccoon covered in bark is observing you curiously from an open spot. It blends in well with the surrounding forest, making you wonder how many other raccoons are hidden in plain sight.

beesandflowers.intro: Tiny, glowing forms hover around a tall, beautiful flower. They land on the flowers and drink the lunar nectar that floats from their centers like dust, taking turns going to each. They appear to be dancing, and never seem to get in the way of each other.

bisoncalf.intro: A lone lunar bison calf is grazing calmly. Its glowing fur is visible from afar, and you cannot see any others of its kind nearby. What a great opportunity!

bobcathare.intro: You find yourself at the center of a hunt. A lunar hare dashes in front of your eyes, followed closely by a bobcat. Neither of them pay any attention to you. You observe them for a brief moment before deciding to make the best of this situation.

bograccoon.intro: A slimy creature, dripping in dark water, approaches you with a nasty expression. This Bog Raccoon might cheer you up, but only if you have something interesting to offer.

cactusgrowth.intro: An entire tiny ecosystem is growing on top of this cactus in the desert. This spot must be great for luring in lunar essence within the underground water canals. You wonder if you can thrive off of it.

cariboufawn.intro: A caribou fawn has caught your attention from afar. With its glowing fur it's easy to spot, and it appears to be wandering alone.

Find mom: Automatic battle with enemy Lunar Caribou

chattylunarwarbler.intro: A very chatty Lunar Warbler is singing a tale of a nest made of wonderfully scented yarrow for his princess.

chucklingtala.intro: You spot a familiar face in this strange world - it's Tala! She watches you for a moment, then chuckles gently, which makes you feel more than a little uneasy. Is it really her?

circlingorbs.intro: Unidentified glowing orbs are circling around you. You feel uneasy.

climbingsloth.intro: Bright blue moss hangs from a tree in front of you, stirring gently in the wind. It shifts and then--it moves! Two glowing eyes open and stare at you. Shaking your head to clear it, you look again and realize it's not moss at all. It's a sloth!

clingycrow.intro: It's not unusual that crows are curious about everything, but this one is starting to cross the line of your patience. You try your best to ignore the bird, but it won't stop flying around you, sitting on your head, and making noises. That's enough!

cnithariancuckoo.intro: A glowing cuckoo flies above your head, preparing to land nearby.

cnithariandame.intro: You recognise this Cnitharian wolf from afar—this is someone you usually buy items from. She seems concerned, pacing back and forth restlessly. Upon noticing you, she nods slightly and immediately shares her worries. Her partner was supposed to arrive some time ago and has yet to show up.

cnitharianfox.intro: A Cnitharian Fox is preparing the area and setting up a trading post to exchange goods with wolves.

cnitharianlady.intro: You notice a lone Cnitharian wolf in front of you. She kindly asks if you need any help and explains you can refresh and heal yourself with her products.

cnitharianmice.intro: Jellyfish-like Cnitharian Mice are gathering supplies for the time when lunar essence is more scarce.

cnitharianpair.intro: A gentle glow on a nearby hill catches your attention. After taking a few steps in its direction, you spot the ladies from the Lunar Shoppe chilling together in a blossoming grass patch. It seems they're taking some downtime to relax.

cnitharianshopkeeper.intro: It takes a while for you to realise why this wolf seems so familiar... Oh! Now you recognise her! This is a shopkeeper you occasionally buy from! She seems preoccupied, looking for interesting items to sell, but she still greets you with a warm smile that shows she recognises you as well.

cnitharianwolffish.intro: You hear a voice from the water calling to you. A cnitharian wolf with a beautiful fishtail adorned with glowing frills is swimming nearby, playing in the waves. This world never ceases to amaze you.

collaredpika.intro: An extremely cute lunar pika sits on a trunk, gathering small, unfamiliar glowing flowers. How adorable.

cottontailburrow.intro: Your instincts never fail you, despite this being a strange world. The shape of a rabbit catches your attention despite the oddity of its appearance. When you come closer, the glowing rodent disappears into its burrow, and you can't help but think that it looks way more appealing than the option of trying to catch a late-night snack.

cragraccoon.intro: A Crag Raccoon with rock-like growths on its back is trying to break open a stone containing glowing essence. It notices you, and asks if you'd like to share your wolf strength.

crestedlunarchipmunk.intro: An adorable crested chipmunk is digging around, probably looking for food.

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from common lunar pool*

crestedlunarjay.intro: With a quiet flutter, a Crested Lunar Jay perches on an oddly shaped rock. It seems to be catching glowing spores to feed.

crestedmink.intro: The creature in front of you looks like a mink, but its head and tail glow - and it seems more curious than afraid of you.

curiousspidermonkey.intro: The dark, elongated shape of a lunar spider monkey swings on lianas, but you can tell the creature is observing you cautiously. Its glowing eyes give it a slightly scary appearance, though it seems to be playful and is interested in you.

dancingcnitharianwolves.intro: You stumble upon a very personal moment. Two Cnitharian Wolves are dancing together in the moonlight. It seems playful, but full of harmony and serenity at the same time.

dancingdragonflies.intro: Fluttering dragonflies appear to be dancing. You hear the susurrus of their metallic wings, rhythmically creating faintly audible melodies.
details: If you cannot store or collect that much daily Lunar Essence, you are instead rewarded with +2-0 LE.

doefawn.intro: A blue glow shines through the leaves. Following closer, you see a lunar doe with a fawn following her every step.

Follow: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random herb from Deciduous Forest*

details: This result is currently unconfirmed to reward SC.

dreamdevourer.intro: A terrifying screech freezes you in your tracks - only to witness a massive glowing pig, drooling and burping. It seems to have insurmountable hunger in its reddish eyes - and this is a color you don't often see in the Dreamlands, and you swallow as you watch it eyeing you hungrily. You notice movement in its red, glowing belly. What nightmares brew inside?
details: If you cannot store or collect that much daily Lunar Essence, you are instead rewarded with +9-1 LE.
If you cannot store or collect any more daily Lunar Essence, you are instead given nothing.

eelgrebe.intro: Ah! From a distance, you thought this creature was an eel, but up close it resembles a grebe. It slithers its long, slimy neck into the water to grab some shiny fish.

essenceparticles.intro: Flickering dust falls from the sky. Tiny, blue, smoky trails resemble rain in slow motion.

essenceswirls.intro: Heavy wind picks up the lunar essence from the ground and paints beautiful swirls in the air with it.

essencetailedhawk.intro: A majestic hawk swoops down low next to you, then flies back up in the air. Essence streaks from its tail, creating a beautiful trail as it flies. It's circling you, observing you with intelligent eyes.

feedingravens.intro: A flock of Lunar Ravens is feeding on glowing fruit found among the branches of a withered tree.

fernraccoon.intro: A small, fern-covered raccoon rolls out from the forest underbrush and sits in front of you. It asks if you're looking for hidden treasures.

floatingsealpup.intro: You have no idea how a seal pup can float on a large bubble, but that's what you see. Your expression makes the pup laugh. It approaches you, and while you still try to figure the bubbles out, it invites you to play a game where you always win. How could you not participate? All you have to do is pop one of the bubbles!

floweringclams.intro: You notice a clump of clams that look familiar, but you are used to expecting being surprised while travelling across these lands and doubt these are ordinary clams.

flutteringbutterflies.intro: Beautiful butterflies with glowing patterns are investigating the luminous flowers nearby.

fluvialraccoon.intro: With a loud splash, a Fluvial Raccoon jumps out of the water to greet you! It whips its watery tail around, eagerly waiting for you to decide if you're interested in some riverine wares.

flyingfish.intro: This world is full of wonders, but the sight of flying fish might be one of the strangest. You watch their graceful movements, holding your breath as if any sudden movement might cause this sight to disappear into thin air.

flyinggannet.intro: A big Lunar Gannet is landing right in front of you—a perfect, vulnerable moment!

foraginggrosbeak.intro: Looks like a grosbeak is foraging for useful sticks. It's carrying a branch, shaking off some little critters from between the leaves.

Grab the branch: +1 LT|imglt//+3% hunger//+1 random herb from Taiga*

foxsquirrel.intro: This little fox squirrel seems to be guarding something that you cannot see. Its long, glowing tail looks like a blue flame.

frozenmushrooms.intro: There are some mushrooms here, covered in ice. Perhaps they were able to grow during a warmer day, but for now, they're trapped in time.

fungalarch.intro: It's impossible to walk past this... thing... without taking a closer look. An impressive arch covered in glowing fungi and various plants could be a gate to another realm, but you're already in one. Patches of rocks and wood can be seen between the growths, giving a hint of the arch's original shape. It looks so ancient that it surely hides some surprises for anyone patient enough to look for them.

Dig: +1 LT|imglt//+1 Bat Carcass//+1 Volukros Squeaky Toy|imgbatcarcass;imgvolukrossqueakytoy

giantmantis.intro: A giant mantis rests on a rock, just as still as everything else around it is. If not for the gentle movements of its antennae, you'd guess it was a statue.

gianttreesparrow.intro: That's one big tree sparrow, alright! Instead of living on a tree, this bird is a living tree itself!

glowingbumblebee.intro: A very polite Bumblebee is approaching a glowing flower. It's having trouble aiming at the flower with its huge, fluffy body. Fascinated, you watch the whole scene unfold.

glowingmoths.intro: In the distance, lights dance and swirl across the hills. As the source of light moves closer, you see they are in fact glowing moths, spreading lunar dust across the lands.

glowingrain.intro: Rain isn't that unusual, but this kind of rain... You notice the droplets are glowing. The tiny splashes spread lunar essence on the ground.

glowingskull.intro: What an interesting find! It's a wolf skull, but... it doesn't appear to be lifeless. The lunar essence surrounds it, making it seem like the skull's owner is calling you from the other side.

glowingspiderweb.intro: Ack! This massive, glowing cobweb blends in so well with the flickering and glowing environment. You almost walked right into it! It's a great idea to set a trap like this... It's so big.

growtharmadillo.intro: An Armadillo is waddling through the forest. You spot massive growths on its back. It looks like a microforest for insects travelling through a glowing universe.

growthcollaredpeccary.intro: It's quite hot in the desert, but the heat doesn't seem to bother this peccary. Its collar is big and fluffy. Perhaps the fluff helps with cooling it down?

growthicicles.intro: You find a world made of ice... or just mushrooms and flowers coated in it. The glow coming from the inside is hypnotising.

growthcrab.intro: A massive crab, overgrown with glowing mushrooms and foliage, is crawling on the surface. Does the underwater world look the same as this place, full of glowing fish and seaweed?

growthmice.intro: Lunar Mice are gathering around a mushroom growth spurt. There's so much food and lunar essence!

growthseaturtle.intro: A large lunar turtle approaches you from the air. Wait, what? It's flying! How is that even possible?! The growths on his shell resemble an underwater forest. Whatever they are, they almost appear to be pulsating with an otherworldly shine. The creature lands a few steps ahead of you.

growthtamandua.intro: You have to blink twice to understand what's going on. A glowing tamandua is standing proudly on its hind legs and spreading its front paws outwards as if about to hug something. However, there are no other creatures or obstacles around. It just stares at you in silence.

hatchingmothwolves.intro: What's that noise? You spot a nearby branch, which seems to be emanating crackling sounds and... high-pitched yelps? Oh, it's a nest! Instead of birds, you find baby moth-wolves!

healingitchyraccoon.intro: Hey! This raccoon appears to be infested with fleas, but he looks quite healthy! Maybe a dose of medicine could cure him fully? Unless you know some good grooming tricks...?

hognosedskunk.intro: A hog-nosed skunk wanders around with confidence. Its glowing fur looks very pretty, and you briefly wonder about its scent.

hornedlunarchipmunk.intro: What's that? A chipmunk with tiny, glowing horns... It looks curiously at you from the tree trunk.

hornedlunarjay.intro: Watch out! It looks like a Horned Lunar Jay is startled by your presence, but it's not willing to just fly away. Maybe it's protecting something?

howlingwolf.intro: You spot a wolf from afar. It's howling at the moon. It exhales blue lunar essence, forming a reflection in the sky.

huntinglunarshrike.intro: You stop suddenly to observe a Lunar Shrike on a vicious hunt!

huntingtoad.intro: A spiny blue lunar toad sits nearby, its tongue flinging out as it snatches bugs from the air. As it devours the bugs, sparks of blue light up its throat as it consumes the lunar essence that the bugs are full of. Cool!

icegull.intro: Quiet clinks catch your attention. You spot a shiny gull with feathers made of ice preening on a glacier. When you approach, it takes a deep breath and lets out a loud, ear-shattering honk.

iceraccoon.intro: A spiky-looking Ice Raccoon chatters its teeth at you, asking if you're looking for something. It's not a threat, the critter is just very cold!

itchyraccoon.intro: This raccoon-looking creature is scratching its ear. But... it has no ears... is it scratching a phantom itch? Or are the little Lunar Fleas bothering it?

jungleraccoon.intro: A very playful Jungle Raccoon slides down a vine to take a closer look at you. Instead of giving you upside-down kisses, it offers you some tropical wares!

kangaroorat.intro: A Lunar Kangaroo Rat is foraging among nearby shrubs.

Forage as well: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random herb from Desert*//+10% hunger

kingfisher.intro: Visibly in pain, a kingfisher unsuccessfully tries to remove something from its wing.

knollraccoon.intro: You almost stepped on a clump of moving grass! It's a Knoll Raccoon, overgrowth with grass to blend in with its surroundings. It asks if you were looking for something in the grass.

lichenraccoon.intro: A Lichen Raccoon mom is showing her kit how to map a path to their home on the horizon. You're noticed by the kit, and the nervous mother asks if you're interested in some extra bonus offers, as she's about to move her shop soon.

lichenrocks.intro: You stop to sniff around this fascinating spot. There are so many scents! This area is especially interesting. Which do you decide to check out?

loggrowth.intro: A fallen log gives shelter to many tiny Lunar Critters. The growth transforms the essence into a tiny, edible cave for a multitude of creatures.

longtaileddeerfawn.intro: A curious fawn approaches you carefully, trying to sniff you.

longtailedjackrabbit.intro: A blue glow flashes in front of your eyes. It's a jackrabbit with an incredibly long tail! It's as fast as the wind and leaves a fading trail of shimmering particles behind it.

lostwhitetailfawn.intro: You notice a trembling fawn looking back and forth as if searching for something. Its spots glow like unknown constellations in the dark sky.

lunaralaskamarmot.intro: This very fluffy and grumpy Alaskan Marmot climbs onto a rock just to sit down and yell at things. Maybe you can do something nice for him today?

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+50 HP//+1 random recipe from lunar acorn pool**
Play!: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random herb from Tundra*//-4 HP

lunaralbatross.intro: A beautiful Lunar Albatross is trying to land, but the weather is very windy. Its feathers are full of lunar dust that clung to its body during its flight.

lunaranteater.intro: The long, elegant fur of this Lunar Anteater leaves a glowing trail of lunar essence on the ground. Various insects gather around it to grab what they can. You realise the strange animal is feeding off of the bugs with this simple lure.

lunaramphiuma.intro: This odd snake has tiny hands and a goofy face! It looks like this is a Lunar Amphiuma, and it dwells in water. Does it breathe air? How can it fly? What does it eat?

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from common lunar pool*

lunarbat.intro: A mystical Lunar Bat crosses your path! The glow from its flapping wings is hypnotising.

lunarbighornsheep.intro: A large big horned sheep blocks your path. It has a beautiful set of wings spread wide and imposing. It's different than the sheep you've seen, but it smells the same and you wonder if it tastes the same, too.

lunarbittern.intro: Splashing sounds lead you to the sight of lunar bittern wading in the shallow water, but it's doing so carefully as if it's looking for something. The more you observe the bird, the more curious you become.

lunarbrant.intro: You find a Northern Brant and a Sparrow cuddling together for warmth. They haven't noticed you yet. What an odd and vulnerable pair.

lunarbrocket.intro: An adorable Lunar Brocket is quite nervous to be feeding around you, but the plants growing in this area are too delicious to pass up.

lunarcardinal.intro: You hear the hushed sound of flapping wings nearby. A Lunar Cardinal is flying by in a hurry, and it does not seem to be aware of your presence.

lunarcatbird.intro: Wow! What is that creature? Is it a bird or a cat? Or... both? Nothing can surprise you in this world anymore.

lunarcentipede.intro: This huge, skittering Lunar Centipede is easy to notice, thanks to the glowing trail left behind it. Its undulating legs and wiggly antennae are making you horribly uneasy. Why is it so BIG?!

lunarchipmunks.intro: You spot movement on the lower branches of a tree. Approaching carefully, you observe Lunar Chipmunks gathering nuts. The way they jump makes you think of how gravity works on the moon. Their leaps are so tall and dream-like!

lunarcoyotepup.intro: A very friendly lunar coyote pup is playing alone among the rocks. You don't see its parents or siblings anywhere but the pup doesn't seem to feel abandoned. What's more, it starts to run towards you!

lunarcoypu.intro: With a soft splashing sound, a lunar coypu travels along the river shore as it inspects the area. Its long, glowing, raised tail looks fascinating. It lures you over to the creature.

Join: +1 LT|imglt//+3 SC|imgsc|(<5000 SC)//+1 Medicine: Healing Salve|imgmedicinehealingsalve

lunarcrossbill.intro: Ah! A Lunar Crossbill just flew by, carrying a large cone in its beak! You trace the essence trail from its wings and focus on the spot where it landed.

lunarcrow.intro: A quirky Lunar Crow is observing your movements. It circles around you from time to time.

lunarcuckoo.intro: A pretty, glowing bird sits calmly on a branch, observing you with curiosity. You recognize the species after taking a second glance. It's definitely a cuckoo and it's probably equally surprised by the sight of a wolf without any blue sparks on its fur.

lunardove.intro: A peaceful Lunar Dove is flying between the branches and the ground. Perhaps it's building a nest.

lunardragonflies.intro: Beautiful glowing dragonflies are racing along the river bank.

lunarduck.intro: Gentle quacks echo in the night. A duck out of water seems like a nice midnight snack.

lunareaglenest.intro: You see a large bird's nest, but its scent is faint and difficult to recognize. There is nothing inside, and it appears to be abandoned.

Destroy: Automatic battle with enemy Charged Eagle

lunaregret.intro: A graceful, glowing egret looks ethereal and beautiful beyond words as it struts before you. In your world, you'd probably look at such a bird with the urge to catch it, but as it wades through the shimmering water you find yourself entranced by its beauty.

lunarferalcat.intro: You hear violent hissing nearby! Fearing it may be a snake, you check out where the sound is coming from. The source is a feral cat, whose eyes glow stronger with every angry hiss it releases.

lunarferret.intro: A Lunar Ferret is hopping around between many burrow, playing out in the open plains.

lunarflamingo.intro: For a moment, you thought this was a big, tropical flower, but... it's a bird! This Lunar Flamingo is resting in the quiet underbrush.

lunarfoxkits.intro: You find three small fox kits huddled together, drawn to their location by their crying. You can't smell an adult nearby. They must have been left alone so their mother could hunt. As you approach they cower together in fear.

lunarfoxsnake.intro: The sight of a fox with snake-like features causes a chill to run down your spine. It notices you, slowly turning its big, reptilian eyes towards you.

lunarfrog.intro: You smell something intense. You lower your head and spot a strong glow in the understory. A small Lunar Frog is sitting under the leaves, absorbing some night-time moisture full of lunar dust.

lunargecko.intro: A slight movement between nearby stones catches your eye. You see a gecko, leaving tiny glowing footprints on the rocky surface.
details: This result is currently unconfirmed to reward SC.

lunargopher.intro: A Lunar Gopher is digging a new burrow! It's so focused on its task that it hasn't noticed you yet.

lunargrackle.intro: Two grackle fly and hop around in the sweet, essence-filled air among the grass. They chirp and forage for insects, occasionally flying up and settling on a new spot. Their carefree nature gives you a warm feeling, and you decide to approach.

lunargroundsquirrel.intro: An adorable, long-tailed lunar ground squirrel is busy looking for something in the grass. It's so focused on its task that it ignores everything around it.

lunargrouse.intro: It looks like a Lunar Grouse is building a nest under a bush. A beautiful Grouse House, so to speak.

lunarguillemot.intro: The sight of a flock of guillemots lifts your mood considerably. Their presence usually means that the area has an abundance of food, which is a rarity in this unfriendly land.

lunargulls.intro: A flock of Lunar Gulls loudly squawks in this area. You think they may be protecting something cool they've found, but they don't know how to extract it.

lunarhawk.intro: A bright blue light dashes in front of you! A Lunar Hawk is hunting here.

lunarheron.intro: A quiet splash reveals a spot where a Lunar Heron is catching food in the shallow water.

lunarhoarymarmot.intro: A hoary marmot perches on a nearby rock, sniffing the air and peering around like it's on the lookout for something. It turns and looks at your with beady eyes, going very still.

lunarhornedlark.intro: A Lunar Horned Lark is passing by on its way to gather food. It seems surprised by your presence!

lunarhornedowl.intro: This magnificent Horned Owl is observing all who pass through this place. As you seem to be an outsider, you're asked about the destination of your travels.

lunarjacana.intro: A Lunar Jacana walks carefully across the water's surface. Its long toes, creeping with essence, help it stay afloat on the gentle foliage covering the waters of this swamp.

lunarjackrabbit.intro: A Lunar Jackrabbit stops gracefully to observe you from a safe distance. Gentle blue smoke is rising from its ticked fur.

lunarjaeger.intro: A graceful Lunar Jaeger seems to be circling around some nests that were destroyed by a rockslide.

lunarlarks.intro: Horned Larks are gathering on a twisted tree, interested in something hidden from your eyes. Dark blue essence resembles smoke, but nothing is burning. There's a little hole in the trunk from where the mist is coming from. You could put something in or take something out.

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+1 Flickering Flower|imgflickeringflower//+1 random recipe from lunar acorn pool*

lunarlemming.intro: A Lunar Lemming is nervously scurrying around, gathering essence-covered foliage for supplies during the darker nights.

lunarlemmingcolony.intro: You rarely see such a display of pure affection. Glowing lemmings are playing, cuddling, and apparently having a good time. They have likely already noticed you, but they don't seem to see you as a threat right now.

lunarlizard.intro: There isn't any sunlight, so this lizard must be... moonbathing? Soaking in the essence?

lunarlynxcubs.intro: You stumble upon two Lunar Lynx Cubs playing on a path between large conifers. They notice you and take a few steps back.

lunarmagpie.intro: A quiet caw causes you to look up. A Lunar Magpie, covered in glowing essence dust, is trying to get your attention. The branch's leaves rustle gently in the wind, reflecting light in a flickering manner.

lunarmargay.intro: You startle a Lunar Margay, who was trying to stalk some birds in the thicket.

lunarmarten.intro: A curious lunar marten sniffs around, most likely looking for food.

lunarmeadowlark.intro: The pleasing sound of a lone bird lures you to this location from far away. You discover a lunar meadowlark on a dry branch. The bird is engrossed in singing, putting his whole heart into it.

lunarmink.intro: A small mink runs by, a small rodent in its mouth. The rodent is still alive, and and squirms in the animal's mouth, trying desperately to get free. The mink stops and drops it on the ground, tearing the little creature apart and making a nice meal before noticing you. Eesh!

lunarmockingbird.intro: This creepy, chuckling bird reminds you of a jackal. It calls you names, taunting you to come closer.

lunarmoosecalf.intro: You hear a loud call reverberating through the trees. Following it, you come upon a young moose calf. It seems to have become separated from its mother. It looks at you warily as you approach.

lunarmountaingem.intro: With a loud tweet, a brilliant lunar mountaingem bird perches in front of you, curious about an unusual guest. You can't take your eyes off of its shiny growths!

lunarmousenest.intro: A tiny nest built in the high grass catches your attention. It looks abandoned at first glance but you notice a gentle blue glow upon going closer. There is a small mouse inside, looking at you with fear.

lunarmudpuppy.intro: A blue glow shines within the murky water of a small, dark pond. It resembles a fish, but when you take a closer look, you notice tiny limbs attached to a snake-like body. The creature is so bizarre that you can't stop staring.

Poke It: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random herb from Riparian Woodland*

lunarmurre.intro: A lunar murre flies over your head like a small shooting star, leaving a trail of a blue glow behind. It's a good chance to test your speed.

lunarmuskrat.intro: A large branch waves through the air in front of you, causing you to stop abrupty and stare. What on earth? It comes closer, and you realize it's being held by a muskrat lumbering along without a care in the world.

lunarocelotcubs.intro: Young ocelot cubs are chasing a glowing butterfly, stopping from time to time to wrestle playfully.

lunarolingo.intro: A small, fluffy creature peeps from a branch, asking for a second of your time. There is no hesitation in its voice, and you have a feeling that everyone on this path has been approached. Your intuition was right; your big, strong paws are needed to destroy the hiding spot of another animal. In exchange, you can keep anything else you find besides the item you're asked to return. You don't know if it's a good idea, but you decide to help anyway.

lunaroriole.intro: A bright blue orb is bothering a Lunar Oriole. No matter where it sits, the orb follows.

Chase the Orb: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random herb from Deciduous Forest**

lunarotter.intro: A very energetic Lunar Otter is playing around on the sandy slope. It seems quite curious about you!

lunarpheasant.intro: This Lunar Pheasant seems unfazed by everything that approaches it, including a wolf. It must have a thick skull to survive with such a thick brain.

lunarprairiedogcolony.intro: A colony of fluffy, glowing prairie dogs is busy going about its business, but you know they are all watching you.

lunarpuffin.intro: You startled a poor Lunar Puffin! Its feathers swirl in the air as it flies away!

lunarpython.intro: A sudden movement and a cracking sound catch your attention. As you approach, you notice a large python coiled up on a branch. It appears that its nest is somewhere nearby, but you would never expect to find a snake's eggs in a tree.

lunarquail.intro: A pudgy Lunar Quail is patrolling this path. It could be looking out for dangers... Or it may just be looking for a partner.

lunarrabbit.intro: A glowing line of zig zags crosses your path. Inside, you spot a rabbit, who has paused to nibble on something.

lunarroadrunner.intro: A fast-moving trail of blue glow catches your attention in the dark. It's hard to focus your eyes on it but when you succeed, you recognize a lunar road runner. There's no way you're passing this challenge up.

lunarrobin.intro: You're startled by a loud fluttering noise. A Lunar Robin has flown up close to check you out!

lunarsambardeerdoe.intro: A graceful doe crosses your path. Her mouth, eyes, and hooves glow, making her look both fascinating and eerie.

Kill: +1 LT|imglt//+1 Doe Carcass|imgdoecarcass//+1 Essence-Covered Fur Clump|imgessencecoveredfurclump

lunarsheep.intro: You find some Lunar Sheep gathering on these dreamy pastures. You're trying to count them, but the process makes you dizzy.

lunarskua.intro: A scary Lunar Skua is patrolling the icy shores. Watching the lights flicker underneath the water from the sky must be mesmerising.

lunarsparks.intro: This phenomenon seems... new to you. Lunar essence is everywhere in this world, but this is the first time you've seen it sparkle and emit sizzling sounds. Beautiful and unknown, it attracts you to it in an instant.

lunarspinylizard.intro: Bright blue with violet spikes running down its spine make this lizard both highly noticeable and send off alarm bells in your head--brightly colored animals can be poisonous! The lizard knows it, too; it doesn't even bat an eye at your approach.

lunarsquirrel.intro: A Lunar Squirrel is hopping around, looking for some food.

lunarstoat.intro: A Lunar Stoat is trying to climb a rocky formation to investigate something interesting! Perhaps you can cooperate?

lunarsurfbird.intro: A lunar surfbird walks slowly along the rocky shore. It doesn't seem to be in a rush; in fact, it almost looks as though it's sightseeing, rather than looking for food or scouting.

lunarswallow.intro: A Lunar Swallow darts in front of you, leaving a smoky blue trail behind. The trail still hovers in the air, even after the bird turns and swoops over the water.

lunartarantula.intro: You spot something creeping on nearby rocks. That's... a lot of legs. You're only mildly relieved that it isn't a gigantic Lunar Tarantula. Just a normal-sized one that happens to be WAY too close to your face for comfort.

lunartortoise.intro: You observe a Lunar Tortoise. Its shell holds an intricate pattern that glows in a mesmerising rhythm.

lunartoucans.intro: You come across some squabbling toucans. They appear to be fighting over essence-charged fruit laying around the area.

lunarwhale.intro: A massive, whale-shaped Lunar image is drawn onto the sky, almost like a very dynamic, moving part of the aurora borealis. You can almost hear the whale's call echoing across the sky.

lunarwoodpecker.intro: This Lunar Woodpecker drills glowing patterns in the tree. Instead of eating insects, it licks off the sap with swirling essence.

lunaryucatansquirrel.intro: A tiny ball of glowing fur on a thick leg turns out to be a squirrel, using its tail to reach the sparks of lunar light floating slowly in the air. It looks like innocent fun and the squirrel is completely absorbed, ignoring everything around it.

markedstone.intro: You approach the stone slowly. You've never seen anything like this, even in this strange world. Odd, mystic signs are glowing from the inside as if the stone is a source of unknown power.

mossraccoon.intro: A lazy Moss Raccoon is resting in your way. It's not interested in moving when an outsider like you appears on the path. When you ask if it has any wares to offer, it sighs. "Yeah, sure, if you insist."

mountaingoatkid.intro: A curious mountain goat kid tilts its head slightly, watching you.

muskoxcalf.intro: A lunar muskox calf wanders around, looking lost. It's a very tempting sight for a hungry wolf.

nobaby.intro: A sudden, unexpected sight has stopped you in your tracks. This baby wolf... there's something wrong with it. You're deeply unsettled by its empty gaze, but you're terrified to look away. This wolf isn't like the other creatures you've seen, and you can't find a trace of lunar essence on its plain fur. Is it phasing through the world temporarily?

orbchasers.intro: A group of Lunar Sparrows is chasing lunar orbs. Is this their food, or are they bullying some mystic creatures? You aren't quite sure.

pawprinttree.intro: A glowing paw print on a tree might be a warning from the local wolves to turn back.

perchedchickadee.intro: A tiny chickadee is watching you from its tiny branch on a spot that's hard to reach.

perchedlunarrobin.intro: A small, glowing bird sits on a nearby branch, looking at you with caution.

pherrisforge.intro: You've just discovered an entrance to the Pherris forge. Lunar fire silently dances, casting a mosaic of shadows on the shimmering snow. The view is both beautiful and dangerous. It's a rare opportunity to explore such a place.

Check the surroundings: +1 LT|imglt//+1-5 SC|imgsc|(<5000 SC)//+1 Pherris Rolling Ball|imgpherrisrollingball

pherrisrat.intro: A loud screech causes you to halt and look intensely at an indentation in the rugged terrain. A large, reddish Pherris Rat is aggressively trying to taunt you!

plainsraccoon.intro: You see a clump of grass swimming among the waves of tall grass. Suddenly, a Plains Raccoon emerges to check you out!

pocketgopher.intro: A Pocket Gopher is peeking out from its burrow. When the moon is up, it's time to gather food.

prancinghorsefoal.intro: A carefree foal prances around, enjoying itself. You don't see any adult horses around which is strange. Perhaps it's not as dependent on its mother as foals in your world?

puffincrab.intro: What lies before you makes you think that a deep sea horror nested on land. A puffin-like crab hybrid is hungrily cleaning the rocks from mussels and lichen.

quetzalbasilisk.intro: A slender lizard peeks out from the foliage, laying its gaze upon you with a curiously twisted head. Slowly, the fantastic feathers on its body fluff up, as it shows you a mouthful of pointy teeth.

raventrader.intro: An intense shine catches your attention. Upon approaching the shine, you notice a lunar raven carefully arranging various items, as if putting them on display. You might be able to find something useful here.

restingcormorant.intro: A cormorant is resting, letting its wings dry slowly in the damp air. The essence seems to help the water evaporate faster. It looks like there are some leftover fish around—perhaps the meal time is over.

restingpetrel.intro: You can just barely spot a resting petrel among the grass and mushrooms up ahead.

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from common lunar pool**
Dig Around: +1 LT|imglt//+5% hunger//+1 random herb from Glacier*

roughleggedbuzzard.intro: A handsome buzzard sits proudly on a branch, its eyes scanning the area for any movement of prey. Lunar essence pours off of its feathers and as you approach, its intense eyes seem to stare right through you and into your soul.

sandraccoon.intro: The long, flowing tail of this Sand Raccoon crumbles in the wind like the edge of a dune, but it doesn't seem to actually dissolve. With a melancholy look in its eyes, the creature asks if you need anything.

singinglunarfinch.intro: This Lunar Finch's song is so loud, vibrant, and clear, you can visibly see the sound vibrating in the air by its glowing essence trail. Suddenly, you hear a horrible break in the song. Then another one. The bird seems to be sick.

singingtapir.intro: Wow! At first, you only heard a song, but then a whole overgrown tapir appeared! It prances about while raising its nose, singing into the night.

skunkowl.intro: An odd creature lands on your path. Is it an owl, or a skunk?

Growl: +1 LT|imglt//+2% energy//+1 Large Bird Meat|imglargebirdmeat//-2 HP

smallcobwebs.intro: You stumble upon many cobwebs woven by local spiders in the shape of a circle.

sparklingsnow.intro: The flecks of snow tend to reflect the blue glow of this land, but this snow seems to have an extra sparkle to it. You notice the snowflakes are glowing with lunar essence frozen within them!

sporecloud.intro: You accidentally step on some local mushrooms, releasing a large spore cloud. It may be dangerous!

spottedlunarchipmunk.intro: An incredibly fluffy striped chipmunk is checking you out, curious about your exotic looks. It seems interested and wonders if you're hiding anything as special as you!

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from common lunar pool**

spottedlunarjay.intro: A Spotted Lunar Jay is walking around, looking for treats on the ground.
details: This option does '''NOT''' reward any LT|imglt.

stalkinglunaroncilla.intro: It was almost too easy to miss the movement on a nearby upturned root. A Lunar Oncilla is stalking its prey, but your arrival seems to have scared it off. It looks at you, a little upset.

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from common lunar pool**

stripedlunarchipmunk.intro: An incredibly fluffy striped chipmunk is checking you out, curious about your exotic looks. It seems interested and wonders if you're hiding anything as special as you!

Offer Acorn: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from common lunar pool**

stripedlunarjay.intro: What an unusual pattern for a bird! This Striped Lunar Jay doesn't seem to be aware of your presence yet.

tarantulamoth.intro: What's this...?! A literal Tarantula Moth! A flying spider?! Help!

toytinkerer.intro: You hear clanking and whirring from behind a pile of rocks. After a short hike, an amazing workshop reveals itself, hidden between the boulders. A crafty raccoon with funny headwear is tinkering with scraps, essence, and discarded objects, happy to make a treasure out of somebody's trash! She notices you and perks up. "Sorry! I can't sell any of these, I am finishing a big order, but I could give you some blueprints if you're interested!"

Pick a blueprint: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from lunar toy pool*

toytrader.intro: You find an extremely fluffy cat walking with a bag on its back like a human. You bark gently in confusion, catching its attention and gaze of intense, slit eyes. Lucky for you, instead of weapons, the bag is full of scrolls! Apparently, this feline fella is trading toy recipes in exchange for Delicate Meat, a rare fishy treat.

Give Delicate Meat: +1 LT|imglt//+1 random recipe from lunar toy pool*

treeclimbinghare.intro: What you see is definitely a hare, but its claws are very long and sharp, allowing it to climb a tree as fast as a squirrel. How peculiar!

veileddove.intro: A majestic, glowing dove flies above your head. Its unusually long, frilled tail catches your attention.

veiledvireo.intro: You can't stop staring at the long, flowing veils of this bird as it flies above your head. With their slow, graceful movements, it feels as if you are watching something living underwater.

volukroscamp.intro: You're entering Volukros territory... Blue feathers hang on the branches above. Despite their decorative appearance, you know it signifies that going further ahead could be dangerous. However, with some luck, you could benefit from this...

Check the surroundings: +1 LT|imglt//+1-5 SC|imgsc|(<5000 SC)//+1 Volukros Squeaky Toy|imgvolukrossqueakytoy

volukrosrats.intro: A few feathered Volukros Rats are scurrying around, sniffing every nook and cranny as if they were searching for something.

vulturebeaver.intro: You hear loud rustling noises among the trees, before a big bird suddenly swoops down towards the water's edge. You can spot a branch in its mouth, with the creature handling it as though it were a beaver, not a bird.

wanderinglunarcat.intro: A small lunar cat crosses your path, completely confident and calm despite your size and unfamiliar look. In its mind, it sees itself as a mighty hunter and ferocious predator, but to you it's just a glowing furball you want to touch.

wattledlunarchipmunk.intro: You find a wattled chipmunk defending a mound of dirt from a butterfly. It's not going to hurt you, buddy!

wattledlunarjay.intro: A Wattled Lunar Jay is flying around and chattering with its mates, spreading lunar dust unknowingly.

wingedfox.intro: Something dashes above your head and lands in front of you. As the creature folds its wings back, you realize it's a fox, but it doesn't seem to enjoy your company and lets out a warning bark as you take a step toward it.

wingedgecko.intro: The creature above your head resembles a bat, but when youlook closer, you notice that it's actually a flying gecko!

wingedpossum.intro: This southern-looking Winged Opossum is prepping dinner... upside down!

wisefox.intro: This old, wise Lunar Fox is offering helpful advice on how to travel within this phasing world.

Refuse: Automatic battle with enemy Wise Fox

wolfchef.intro: Now that's something you haven't seen before! Looks like this wolf is trying to cook something in an essence-filled kettle, but there's something odd about this scene... The chef's hat is a big mushroom and under it... there's a rat! And this weird rat seems to be pulling the wolf's fur to command the cooking process! You peek into the soup and take a big sniff. Is there something missing?

woollybearmothnight.intro: You can't believe your eyes. You'd say you're dreaming, but you are, in fact, in a Dreamland, so anything is possible. There are no words to properly describe this creature. You'd never imagine a cross between a bear and a moth.

lunarplantapril.intro: You spot a strange glowing plant resembling crops you've grown in your garden. Is this a special variety?

deepmud.intro: At first, the ground is just wet and slippery, but as you walk further, you find yourself in deep mud. The mud slows you down, but you take some odd pleasure in splashing it around.

disturbeddirt.intro: Hmm...the dirt has been displaced here, almost like someone was digging recently. Maybe something valuable is buried?

drycrumblingground.intro: The ground under your paws is so dry that it crumbles under your weight, raising clouds of dust. You cough a little and decide to take a closer look at your footsteps. You're almost certain that you feel something unusual.

nearbycreeksound.intro: The familiar sound of a creek bubbling in the distance draws your pawsteps in that direction. It would be a nice spot to take a breather.

recentearthquakeshiftedground.intro: The ground has shifted due to the recent earthquake, making it much less stable to walk on. However, you hope that all the cracks and holes are full of hidden treasures that would otherwise have remained underground.

rockslidesounds.intro: Your ears catch the sound of rocks crashing down a slope nearby. You probably should stay away to be safe, but your curiosity begs you to check it out.

slippedonarock.intro: Suddenly, you lose the ground under your paws, slipping on a rock and falling to the side. It hurts a little, but you aren't seriously injured.

softground.intro: The ground is soft under your paws here, and your paws itch to dig in it.

ammonitebed.intro: One side of a huge, dark rock slab is completely smooth, but the other side looks like the bottom of the sea, with lots of shells of different sizes still stuck within it. You can tell they're older than any wolf can remember.

ammonitefossil.intro: The beautiful, large, fossilized spiral shape is impossible to be mistaken for anything else. It's a perfectly preserved ammonite. Beautiful! Perhaps you can take it with you.

ancientfossils.intro: Various shapes of plants and small animals are pressed into this rock. You don't recognize any of them. This rock has survived for thousands of years so that you can admire the past.

fossilbed.intro: The ground has collapsed in places, allowing towers of stone to rise up and crumble away to reveal fossils underneath! Are you brave enough to have a look around?

fossilcliffleft.intro: A cliff rises to your left with fossils peeking out from a layer of rock. Maybe you should check it out!

fossilcliffright.intro: A cliff rises to your right with a column of...something crumbling from where it's embedded in the rock. Is it some sort of old human structure?

fossilcliffsplit.intro: This cliff used to be a solid wall of rock, but now it has split and revealed numerous fossils from millions of years ago. What a find! How many are there? It will take ages to look through them all. The sight is fascinating and daunting at the same time.

fossilrelief.intro: These ancient creatures were trapped in this rock for a long time, leaving their shapes imprinted forever. The rock is cracked in many places, making you wonder how much longer it will hold its form.

fossilsandstone.intro: The fossilized bones are deeply embedded in the rock, but their shapes are clearly visible. There must be a way to take them out; perhaps even all of them.

fossilslabs.intro: Perfectly visible against the light surface, the fossils embedded in the rock slabs looked easy to take out, tempting you to try.

fossilwall.intro: This wall towers so high that you can't see the top, and is absolutely riddled with bones and fossils of various sizes and shapes. Who knew so many things lurked just beneath your pawsteps that are only now coming to the surface?

fossilizedtree.intro: From a distance, the remains of the broken tree look ordinary. Upon coming closer, you realize that you don't recognize the type of tree. Its fossilized bark feels strange to the touch.

fossilizedtrunk.intro: The tree in front of you is much older than the forest around it and its scent is slightly different. Its dark bark is as hard as stone, yet it seems fragile, as if it could turn to dust at any moment.

landsliderocks.intro: Rocks have tumbled down the mountain here recently, and look quite strange compared to the plain rocks you normally see. They have strange impressions in them, almost as if there were beings that once dwelled in them...

openfossilbed.intro: There's so many nooks and crannies to explore here! Watch your pawsteps young wolf, you never know what lies beneath the ground.

raisedfossilcliff.intro: Are those...trees in that rock? You move closer, giving the rock a curious sniff. It looks like ferns were pressed into this rock years ago and have left only their imprint behind. How cool!

trilobitedeposit.intro: You almost missed it. A trilobite fossil shape is hidden in the rocky texture, but once you spot it, it's clear and impossible to mistake for anything else.
